name-01.output: Lin Xiao, how come you're here so early today?
name-01.direct: Lin Xiao, why did you come so early today?
name-01.reflect: 直译准确自然，'来得这么早'在英文里说 come in/come here so early 更口语，但 come so early 也通顺；语气是日常问候，保留即可。
name-01.free: Lin Xiao, how come you're here so early today?

context-01.output: Don't worry, I've got it memorized.
context-01.direct: Don't worry, I've already memorized it thoroughly.
context-01.reflect: 直译准确自然，'背熟了'指把内容背得很熟练，英文用 memorized it thoroughly 或 have it memorized 都地道，语气轻松安抚，符合原意。
context-01.free: Don't worry, I've got it memorized.

slang-01.output: That move was insane—I'm literally losing it.
slang-01.direct: This wave of operation is too showy, I directly split open.
slang-01.reflect: 直译完全不通：'这波操作'是网络用语指'这一手/这波操作'，'秀'指厉害/骚气，'裂开'是网络梗表示震惊到崩溃。需要用地道英文网络表达。
slang-01.free: That move was insane—I'm literally losing it.

idiom-01.direct: This is simply drawing legs on a snake.
idiom-01.reflect: 直译保留了成语字面，但英文读者不懂这个典故；英语里有对应习语 gild the lily，表示多此一举、画蛇添足，更地道。

short-01.reflect: 单字应答，语气随意自然，英文用 Yeah 最贴近口语。

corpus-01.output: Teacher, I really did my homework, but the dog ate it.
corpus-01.direct: Teacher, I really did write my homework, but it was eaten by the dog.
corpus-01.reflect: 直译准确，但英文里“dog ate my homework”是众所周知的借口梗，用“the dog ate my homework”更地道，能传达出学生找借口的语气。
corpus-01.free: Teacher, I really did my homework, but the dog ate it.

corpus-02.output: That head tilt was just him sneaking a peek at the lines!
corpus-02.direct: That tilt of the head was sneaking a peek at the words!
corpus-02.reflect: 直译准确传达了意思，但英文里'偷看词'更自然的说法是偷看台词/提示卡，'sneaking a peek at the words'可以，但'tilt of the head'稍显生硬，改为'That head tilt'更口语化。
corpus-02.free: That head tilt was just him sneaking a peek at the lines!

corpus-03.output: Nah, I'm not dating. Keeping a little mystery is nice.
corpus-03.direct: Not dating, keeping a sense of mystery is pretty good.
corpus-03.reflect: “不处”是网络口语，指不处对象、不谈恋爱；“保持神秘感挺好的”语气轻松随意。直译基本达意，但“Not dating”稍显生硬，可更口语化。
corpus-03.free: Nah, I'm not dating. Keeping a little mystery is nice.

corpus-04.reflect: 直译生硬，不符合英语口语习惯。原文表达对某事来得突然的惊讶，英语常用 That was so sudden 或 This is so sudden 来表达。

corpus-05.output: It's just hahaha so random, like who even gets this question
corpus-05.direct: It's just hahaha too abstract, who understands this question
corpus-05.reflect: “太抽象了”是网络用语，指事情离谱、难以理解，直译 abstract 在英文里也能表达“莫名其妙/离谱”的意思，但需要加语气词让口语感更强；“谁懂啊”是流行语，表示共鸣式吐槽，英文对应 who gets it / I can't even。
corpus-05.free: It's just hahaha so random, like who even gets this question

corpus-06.output: Seems like it's true. I even came across some leaked footage from his concert.
corpus-06.direct: Seems like it's true, I even scrolled to leaked videos of his concert.
corpus-06.reflect: "刷到" is internet slang for coming across something while scrolling; "路透" means leaked/spoiler footage from a concert. "好像是真的" responds to something previously said, so "Seems like it's true" works. Need natural phrasing for "刷到" — "came across" or "saw" fits.
corpus-06.free: Seems like it's true. I even came across some leaked footage from his concert.

corpus-07.output: Which class meeting? How come nobody told me?
corpus-07.direct: Which class meeting? How come I didn't hear about it?
corpus-07.reflect: “班会”指班级会议，“我怎么没听着”是口语化的反问，表达没被通知到的疑惑/不满。直译基本准确，但“hear about it”更自然，能传达出“没人告诉我”的语气。
corpus-07.free: Which class meeting? How come nobody told me?

corpus-08.output: Besides, he's got that honest, down-to-earth vibe—so approachable. You're not losing out here. Who knows, you might even use that face to score a free meal.
corpus-08.direct: Besides, his honest and simple temperament is so approachable. You don't lose out this time—maybe you can even mooch a meal with this face.
corpus-08.reflect: “憨厚老实的气质”指人看起来老实可靠、接地气；“亲民”指平易近人、讨人喜欢；“你这波不亏”是网络口语，意为这次不亏、划算；“靠这张脸蹭顿饭”指凭长相白吃一顿饭。直译基本达意，但“this time”略生硬，“mooch a meal with this face”可更口语化为“use that face to score a free meal”。
corpus-08.free: Besides, he's got that honest, down-to-earth vibe—so approachable. You're not losing out here. Who knows, you might even use that face to score a free meal.

corpus-09.output: Should we throw this souvenir away?
corpus-09.direct: Should this souvenir be thrown away?
corpus-09.reflect: 直译准确自然，'要不要'表达的是征询意见，英文用'Should we...'更口语化，补出主语we更符合对话场景。
corpus-09.free: Should we throw this souvenir away?

corpus-10.output: That idea of yours is pretty out there.
corpus-10.direct: Your idea is also abstract enough.
corpus-10.reflect: 直译生硬，'够抽象的'是网络流行语，指想法离谱、莫名其妙，英文用'wild'或'out there'更地道，语气带调侃。
corpus-10.free: That idea of yours is pretty out there.

corpus-11.output: Fine. I'll deal with all this toxic positivity once I'm back in China.
corpus-11.direct: Fine, wait until I return to China to deal with these toxic chicken soups.
corpus-11.reflect: "毒鸡汤" is internet slang for motivational/inspirational content that's actually misleading or harmful—literal "toxic chicken soup" would confuse English viewers. "行" here is a resigned/agreeing "fine" or "okay." "等我回国处理" means "wait till I'm back in China and I'll deal with it."
corpus-11.free: Fine. I'll deal with all this toxic positivity once I'm back in China.

corpus-12.output: That short? Hit a creative block?
corpus-12.direct: So short, did you hit a creative bottleneck?
corpus-12.reflect: 直译准确，但"创作瓶颈"在口语英文里更常说"creative block"或"writer's block"，"bottleneck"偏工程术语，不够自然。语气是调侃式反问，需保留。
corpus-12.free: That short? Hit a creative block?

corpus-14.output: Your proposal vs. your colleague's PPT — which one wins?

corpus-14.free: Your proposal vs. your colleague's PPT — which one wins?

corpus-16.free: Damn, why didn't you say so earlier? No wonder you're always posting sunrises on Moments.

corpus-19.free: Look, the winning numbers on the lottery ticket I bought are exactly the same as the ones you mentioned yesterday.

corpus-22.free: Stayed up late last night watching your livestream—laughed so hard my stomach hurt.

corpus-23.free: I was in such a rush to get out the door that I grabbed a rag instead of a towel and took it to work.

corpus-24.output: No thanks—this drama's too much for me to handle.

corpus-27.output: Isn't that how it should be?
corpus-27.direct: Isn't this what it should be?

corpus-27.free: Isn't that how it should be?

corpus-28.output: The boss is marrying the cleaning lady.
corpus-28.direct: The boss is going to marry the cleaning lady.

corpus-29.output: Treadmill, elliptical, or spin bike—which is better for heavier people trying to lose fat?

corpus-31.output: Oh man, I can't even—I'm gonna be laughing about this for a year. Come on, who hasn't had a mortifying story about buying sanitary pads!

corpus-31.free: Oh man, I can't even—I'm gonna be laughing about this for a year. Come on, who hasn't had a mortifying story about buying sanitary pads!

corpus-32.output: I'm already running a fever—please, ladies, just leave me alone.
corpus-32.direct: I'm already running a fever, please let me go, aunties.
corpus-32.reflect: "大妈们" refers to the middle-aged women (often a noisy square-dancing or nagging crowd); "放过我吧" is a plea to be left alone. Literal "let me go" sounds like being physically held; better to say "leave me alone" or "cut me some slack."
corpus-32.free: I'm already running a fever—please, ladies, just leave me alone.

corpus-33.free: Watch Gen Z chat in their cryptic internet slang

corpus-34.free: I keep getting interrupted by messages at work and can't focus. Any tips on how to be more productive?

corpus-38.free: I was scrolling through videos and saw this Shandong lady selling a giant jianbing guozi at her stall. Now I'm suddenly wondering—is Shandong jianbing the biggest in the country?

corpus-39.free: Its 9.4 rating on Douban also proves its quality.

corpus-42.free: Hahaha I can't, this generation of netizens is seriously too funny

corpus-44.free: I'm done. I've worked so much overtime I'm completely numb.
